Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ICAO Doc 9432, FAA PCG and published by Protermify Aviation as a static aviation reference page.

Definition

Activation of an inflatable evacuation slide from an aircraft door to enable rapid passenger egress.

Operational example

Tower, Bravo seven-five-three, slide deployment at door L1 after smoke in cabin, evacuating, request fire and medical services immediately, runway blocked.

Localized term

स्लाइड तैनाती

टावर, ब्रावो 753, केबिन में धुआँ के बाद L1 द्वार पर स्लाइड तैनात, निकासी जारी, तत्काल अग्निशमन और चिकित्सीय सेवाएँ अनुरोध, रनवे अवरुद्ध।
